library_preparation_preflight.summary: pfl-dynamic is a standalone bytecode-generation/object-copying utility with only ordinary transitive Maven dependencies (pfl-basic, asm, asm-util) that Gradle resolves automatically. It uses sun.misc.Unsafe/sun.reflect.ReflectionFactory, which live in the always-exported jdk.unsupported module, so no extra JVM flags, Docker image, or system property is required to reach meaningful coverage on JDK 25.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Optional, not required: the default reflective/Unsafe object copier is exercised without any special setup. If a test also wants to cover the experimental ASM-codegen copier path in ClassCopierOrdinaryImpl, it can set the system property org.glassfish.dynamic.codegen.UseCodegenReflectiveCopyobject=true, but this is not needed for baseline coverage.
risks: The library performs runtime ASM bytecode generation and Unsafe-based field access; if this proves incompatible with Native Image at build/run time, that is a native-image compatibility issue to resolve in code/metadata, not something fixable via the dependency/docker/env-var setup categories covered here.
